title: Dot lifetime
description: How many recent hits stay on the target as dots. The newest 40 are drawn bright; older ones fade. All hits keeps the whole attempt as a dim cloud that brightens where hits cluster. Bias, on-centre, spread and the ellipse always cover the whole attempt.

title: Show 1σ ellipse
description: Outline one standard deviation of the hit cloud around its centroid (the attempt's covariance).

title: Size / %
description: Panel scale; 100 = 320 px wide. Clamped to 60–200.

title: Position anchor
description: Screen edge the panel sits against. Left-middle stays clear of the osu! playfield and HUD at 16:9.

title: Vertical inset / px
description: Distance from the top or bottom edge; for middle anchors, an offset from centre (negative moves up).
